mapper.select: SELECT id,name,brief,description,price,image_url,thumbnail_url,merchant_id, lifecycle_status,business_version,updated_at FROM products WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET name=#{name},brief=#{brief},description=#{description},image_url=#{imageUrl}, thumbnail_url=#{thumbnailUrl},business_version=business_version+1 WHERE id=#{productId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND business_version=#{expectedVersion}
